news.title: A blow for Morocco? Secret agreement leads the 2030 World Cup final to the Santiago Bernabeu
news.lede: The battle has not been officially settled. The media and public rivalry between Spain and Morocco over hosting the 2030 World Cup final rumbles on. FIFA, football's international governing body, sticks to its official position of neutrality, with no final decision yet taken on the venue for the tournament's most important match. The official verdict may be a year away, perhaps not arriving until 2028, yet the current signs look largely clear.

news.title: Philippines women’s national football team secures qualification for 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup
news.lede: News On AIR | March 19, 2026 1:13 PM. The Philippines women’s national football team have secured qualification for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup after defeating the Uzbekistan women’s national football team 2-0 in a Women’s Asian Cup play-in match on the Gold Coast today. Angela Beard delivered a standout performance, opening the scoring early in the second half after earlier missed opportunities. She found the net in the 47th minute with a well-taken strike into the roof of the goal.

news.title: Kunsanama appointed Zambia U-15 head coach ahead of FIFA World Cup
news.lede: Football Association of Zambia (FAZ) has appointed Brian Kunsanama as head coach of the Zambia Under-15 boys’ national team ahead of the inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival. Kunsanama will lead a newly constituted technical bench tasked with preparing Zambia for the global youth tournament, which will be held in Baku, Azerbaijan, from 22 to 31 October 2026. FAZ general secretary Charles Chakatazya confirmed that Kunsanama will be assisted by Lawrence Lubinda, Josephat Nkhoma, Brian Lubaba and Joyford Mambe. Former Zambia and Zanaco goalkeeper Racha Kola has been appointed goalkeeper coach, while Mike Mudenda will serve as physical trainer.

news.title: Cork athletes off to Germany to compete for Ireland in Transplant Football World Cup
news.lede: The Irish team for the Transplant Football World Cup. A team of 10 Irish athletes who had “life-changing” organ transplants will compete at the Transplant Football World Cup this week. The tournament takes place in Frankfurt between September 13 and 18 with teams from around the world competing. Team captain JP O’Neill had a kidney transplant in 1998 and has not spent a day in hospital since then despite years of ill-heath before that.

news.title: They wrote another "drama of the final showdown"! The South Korean women's football team dramatically advanced to the Round of 16 at the U20 World Cup... with a 3-2 victory over Ecuador.
news.lede: The South Korean U20 women's football team, which had been pushed to the brink of elimination in the group stage, has once again written a dramatic final showdown story. Led by head coach Park Yoon-jeong, South Korea defeated Ecuador 3-2 in the final Group C match of the 2026 FIFA U20 Women's World Cup held at the Łódź Stadium in Poland on the 13th (Korean time). Earlier, after drawing 1-1 with France and losing 1-3 to Ghana in their second match, South Korea had been pushed to the brink of elimination. However, a victory over Ecuador propelled them directly to second place in the group and secured their spot in the Round of 16.

news.title: Viral World Cup fan 'Freddy' back in US. See his Cy-Hawk experience
news.lede: A German sports fan who went captured the nation's attention during the World Cup has returned to the United States, and he's right here in Iowa today. The social-media personality behind the popular X account @FreddyLA7 went viral during the World Cup for his reaction to and love for all things American as he traveled the country. Now, he's returned to the States for something that is quintessentially American — college football. His college football tour seems to have started in Iowa for Week 2 of the 2026 season.
